interpretation.structural_interoperability: Schema validation establishes that both corpora use the same record shapes and controlled vocabularies.
interpretation.semantic_interoperability: Human-reviewed mappings are required to establish that evidence is mapped to those shapes with equivalent meaning. The mappings in this matrix are automated proposals pending human review.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Names the institutional subject and classifies its institutional type without importing functions, authority or capacity.
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Each passage directly establishes that a named organizational unit exists.
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: Neither identity passage alone establishes placement, mandate, authority or capacity.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: States the directly evidenced immediate institutional parent.
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Both sources name an intermediate organizational parent rather than only a root institution.
analogous_only: AI division inside NIST laboratory structure
differences_to_preserve: NIST group is nested in a technical division
AI Office is part of a Directorate-General administrative structure
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: Placement does not establish control rights or independent legal status.
schema_limitations: The record stores the immediate parent but does not itself encode the complete ancestry chain.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Uses the Core record-link contract to provide directed graph traversal while preserving direct, inherited or inferred basis.
source_authority_types: Commission establishing decision plus placement record
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Both links traverse part-of relationships, but the NIST-to-Commerce link is direct and the AI-Office-to-Commission-root link is inherited through DG CONNECT.
differences_to_preserve: inherited basis for AI Office root traversal
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: Neither link establishes every parent decision right or degree of control.
schema_limitations: The inherited link cites its placement record but the Core link schema has no explicit chain array.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Captures a source-reported institutional purpose separately from mandate, function and performance.
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Both sources report broad institutional purpose; the Commission source calls it a role, which is retained as uncertainty.
analogous_only: Commission role summarized as mission-like purpose
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: The Commission mapping is proposed because its source says role rather than mission.
schema_limitations: Mission classification can require a review judgment when publisher terminology differs.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Records responsibility assigned by an authority source, scoped to the cited provision and its stored temporal provenance.
source_authority_types: current official OLRC U.S. Code text
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Both passages assign institutional responsibilities, but their authority systems and temporal guarantees differ.
differences_to_preserve: stored NIST source is current only through 2026-08-07
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: The NIST capture does not prove statutory currency after 2026-08-07.
schema_limitations: Source currency must be expressed through provenance and uncertainty rather than inferred from retrieval date.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Records an assigned or source-reported institutional activity without converting it into authority, capacity or performance.
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Both passages directly assign work to an institutional unit.
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: Assigned work does not prove resources, completion or effectiveness.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Records a legally or procedurally authorized institutional decision, including its conditions and authority source.
source_authority_types: Code of Federal Regulations and NIST handbook
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Each example gives the institution discretion to make a scoped procedural decision.
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: The Article 258 reasoned-opinion duty is excluded from this comparison and proposed as a function because its modality is mandatory once conditions hold.
schema_limitations: Review is required to distinguish mandatory procedural duties from discretionary decision rights.

atomic_schemas.shared_schema_definition: Records directly evidenced organizational, physical, programmatic or network machinery with explicit status, type, evidence and optional components, date and quantity.
source_authority_types: official accreditation regulation and program page
atomic_schemas.mapping_rationale: Both examples identify concrete maintained machinery, while components remain institution-specific and passage-supported.
atomic_schemas.uncertainty: The AI Office model-evaluation capacity candidate is omitted because function, legal right and a claim of expertise do not directly prove concrete machinery.
schema_limitations: The schema cannot by itself prove that each normalized component occurs in a selected quotation; corpus tests and review must enforce that mapping.
